run_multigpu_rendering: run the multi-GPU rendering CLI to generate images and videos from a trained NSVF model checkpoint
run_inference_step: run the task inference step to generate rendered frames across a batch of samples using the model ensemble
build_generator: build a generator from the task to handle rendering with test poses and frame sharding across GPUs
merge_videos: merge video shards from all GPUs into a single combined output video after distributed rendering completes
load_model_ensemble: load a model ensemble from checkpoint paths for multi-GPU rendering inference with optional FP16 and CUDA optimization
